props.caption: A fresh VM for every job.
props.done: Deleted when the job is done.

scenes.narration: Each job gets a fresh VM or container, deleted when the job is done. Nothing carries over.

cues.text: Jobs arrive, and the fleet scales to the queue.
Each job gets its own clean instance.
When one fails, the next still starts clean.

props.text: Two macOS jobs at a time, by default.
props.sub: Apple caps macOS VMs at two per Mac. Linux jobs and runners_per_vm go further.

scenes.narration: On a Mac, Apple allows two macOS virtual machines at a time, so the default is two macOS jobs at once. Linux jobs and more runners per VM go further.
